meta.title: Cricleci: establish babel cache
meta.body_summary: Establish CircleCI caching for babel compilation output to speed up CI builds, inspired by a blog post.

perf_labels.notes: PR added CircleCI caching for babel output; closed by author ~3 minutes after creation with no review or discussion.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2984 changed lines, this is a large change by absolute volume, but the majority (2792 lines) came from a merge of master, not from the performance change itself. The actual caching change is only ~8 lines across 3 build files. The PR was self-closed by the author immediately, which is unusual and suggests it may have been opened accidentally or not intended for merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No review feedback available; PR was self-closed without interaction.
review_details.performance_claim: Add babel caching to speed up CircleCI builds.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by author patmmccann less than 3 minutes after creation with no review, suggesting accidental or premature opening.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Minimal CI caching change in build config files; the PR was self-closed, so it did not undergo review. This may indicate a case where the agent-authored change was not intended for merge or was opened in error.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No testing evidence or maintainer evaluation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without explanation; no regression identified.

core_change_summary.description: In .circleci/config.yml, enabled cache for babel-loader output; in webpack.conf.js and webpack.debugging.js, configured cache directory to .babel_cache. The majority of the PR's line changes came from a merge of the master branch, which included many unrelated adapter and test changes.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The massive merge from master (commit 05bebcbd) introduced changes across ~180 files, including integration examples, libraries, modules, and tests, which are unrelated to the caching performance change.
change_trajectory: PR created with many commits, most of which updated AGENTS.md and merged master.
The final commit (618d11d2) added 'chore(ci): cache babel output' with modifications to CI and webpack configs.
PR closed by author less than 3 minutes after creation, before any review.
